checklist: docs/roadmap/tasks/archive/X08-diff-pairs-routing.md (the stage); X09 (the measurement item) runs it
question: On boards with differential pairs (named by KRT's suffix rules), does the krt-diffpair stage (run before the fanout, pairs inferred from net names) leave more pairs coupled (at least half of the pair's copper within ±10 % of the gap) than Freerouting routing them single-ended, without a new clearance violation, a via in a pad or a new unrouted connection? The stage stays selectable either way; it is off by default.

off.engine: freerouting-rs at the commit that lands X08, freerouting-krt's in-process harness (the CLI does not call freerouting_krt::register yet, C07)
off.command: X08_SET=tools/bench/sets/x08-diffpairs.txt X08_RECORDS=<out>/records.json cargo test --release -p freerouting-krt --test diffpair measurement_records_on_a_set -- --ignored --exact --nocapture

settings.all other settings: the defaults (optimizer on, as the CLI)

on.engine: the same commit and harness; a full route with the stage selected
on.command: the same run; one records file holds both arms

boards.dsn: the two synthetic boards in crates/freerouting-krt/tests/data and three boards of F03.3's out-of-repo corpus (target/corpus/prepped, tools/corpus/prep.sh), the same files X07.6 registered

eligibility: decided from the inputs: a board with at least one pair by KRT's naming rules (USB_D+/USB_D-, DVI and PCIe _P/_N names) whose two nets have two pins each. A row with no such pair, or whose pairs the stage skips (more than two pins, no common signal layer), is neutral and printed.
grading: Rust's DRC (DesignRulesChecker: clearance violations, incompletes) and the via-in-pad test of crates/freerouting-krt/tests/diffpair.rs on both arms; the coupling of each pair from freerouting_krt::diffpair::report::coupling on the final board. KiCad grading (F02.6) of the corpus rows' sessions is a second step once the harness writes their SES and C07 registers the stage in the CLI (not graded is never a pass).

metric_definitions.via_in_pad: vias whose centre lies in a pin's pad on a shared layer
metric_definitions.pairs_coupled: the name-inferred pairs with two-pin nets whose copper on their X08 layer is at least half within ±10 % of the gap of the partner's copper (report::coupling share >= 0.5)
metric_definitions.coupled_share_mean: the mean coupling share over those pairs

decision_table.pass: keep krt-diffpair as a selectable stage (off by default); DIVERGENCES.md gets no line (no default changes)
decision_table.fail: a guard regression is a bug to fix before the stage is kept; pairs the stage reports as not routed (all attempts refused by the DRC) and left to the passes are not a failure

timing: the registered run waits for P04's default-tree decision (P00 README 'Order', Q00 README 'Order and critical path'): both arms route, so their numbers depend on the tree; X09 adds coupled vias and the pair-aware optimizer before it runs
